name: Angus McGregor
bio:
Angus McGregor's motorsport journey began in the dusty workshops of rural Victoria, tinkering with engines alongside his father. He quickly developed a knack for identifying bottlenecks and optimizing performance, skills he honed through years of working his way up the ranks. From pit crew member to race engineer, Angus has seen it all. He joined Cavaleiro Sports five years ago and has since been instrumental in streamlining their operations. 

Angus is known for his no-nonsense approach and unwavering commitment to excellence. He believes in empowering his team while holding them accountable for results. His focus is on creating a high-performance environment where everyone is challenged to push their limits. He is especially adept at improving team coordination, ensuring that every department is working in sync toward common goals. Angus's hands-on experience and clear communication style make him a highly effective leader.

What sets Angus apart is his ability to blend traditional motorsport knowledge with modern management techniques. He's not afraid to embrace new technologies but also understands the importance of fundamental skills and a strong work ethic. His demanding personality is balanced by a genuine desire to see his team succeed, making him a respected and valued member of Cavaleiro Sports.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: Angus is a stocky man with a permanent furrow in his brow, radiating intensity.

quirks: Insists on using a physical stopwatch for timing pit stops, even with digital systems in place.
Always carries a well-worn copy of 'Carroll Smith's Tune to Win' and refers to it frequently.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, driving his colleagues slightly mad.
